rows.abstract: The bill seeks to declare sikaran as the national martial art of the Philippines.  Sikaran-arnis is an ancient art of Filipino foot and stick fighting that promotes the virtues of self-discipline and control as well as a healthy and simple lifestyle for the holistic development of the Filipino individual.

rows.abstract: The bill increases the maximum amount for the constitution of a family home from P300,00 to P2.0 million in urban areas, and from P200,00 to P1.5 million in rural areas in order to, at least, approximate the cost of building a decent house under prevailing market prices.

rows.title_short: Comprehensive Commercial Units Rental Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Comprehensive Commercial Units Rental Act of 2004.\" The bill provides that beginning January 1, 2005 until December 31, 2008, the monthly rentals of all commercial units in the National Capital Region and other urban areas shall not be increased by more than the annual average of devaluation of the Philippine peso nor more than 10% cumulative in every year.
